description: Original names sensor/actuator categories but gives no concrete participants or quantities. Wizard explicitly holds both groups open and disables apply/start. No quantities were invented.
Wizard requires connection clarification for Powertrain Domain, Chassis Domain, ADAS Domain and Body Domain. Multiple possible buses and sensor-link alternatives are not confirmed physical bindings.

Behavioral statements and structure headings are treated as unquantified hardware categories: Sensor- und Aktorfehler erkennen und behandeln; Das System verarbeitet kontinuierlich Sensordaten...; Domain-Controller-Design; Direkte Sensorlinks...; Punkt-zu-Punkt-Links....

Known controller aliases CDC/PDC also appear as UNRESOLVED technologies; ordinary words Direkte, Verbindung, Bremsanforderungen and Ethernet möglich are technology candidates. Correct functional-partner meaning is not consistently retained.
CAN-FD is duplicated in proposal under can‑fd and can_fd. The wizard itself lists one CAN_FD family; no canonical duplicate was created.

All168 numbered REQ identifiers are retained. Seventeen non-heading statements from the top-level requirements list do not occur verbatim in the visible source quotes; the entry Das System muss contains just the heading. Semantic equivalence elsewhere has not been established; no claim that17 distinct semantics are certainly lost.
One native UI intake ran from approximately11:02 to11:45:25 Europe/Berlin, around44min. This is observed UI wall time, not an exact native inference benchmark.
